data.completion_memo: Implemented prefix-stable independent review messages: immutable policy, complete user constraints and bounded assistant transcript, workspace, eight bounded recent tool exchanges, exact action last. No hidden provider reasoning or opaque context. 128 KiB total bound fails to human approval if complete constraints/action cannot fit. Borrowed reverse selection stops at eight matches; capped serialization avoids copying large tool outputs. Original execution history is unchanged. Audit verified full exact action and user constraint preservation, stable message prefixes, 2 MB result bounding, provider-context exclusion, failed review usage, denial/human fallback semantics and cancellation behavior. Desktop suite 357 passed/1 ignored, plus recent-record bounded-selection regression passed. Native actual Shell/Python reviews: 1999 and 2740 request bytes, stable prefix, separate accurate 60% fixture cache display. No live DeepSeek hit-rate or cost claim.
data.description: Second implementation step. Stable policy/user constraints/workspace before bounded relevant evidence and changing action. Preserve exact action, denial/cancellation semantics, immutable evidence and real usage on failures. Verify prompt prefixes and bounded evidence growth. Design: docs/approval-cache-accounting.md.
data.title: Make necessary automatic reviews compact and cache-efficient
